status.text:
We're winding down Yupp today. It was a hard decision, but I'm proud of what we built: 1.3M+ users, an amazing community, and a team I'd work with again in a heartbeat. Grateful to everyone who was part of it. 
Thank you thank you thank you.
More here: https://blog.yupp.ai/winddown
